name: Text_BuildCharTransform
signature: float* Text_BuildCharTransform(TextRenderer* self, u32 charIndex, GlyphEntry* glyph, u32 styleId, float* out, int second, float* uvOut)

evidence: Its two callers are Text_BuildGlyphQuads and maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb, i.e. the glyph quad emitters, and the body's std_FastSinCos + 12/16-float writes match a per-glyph transform - the role is confirmed by the caller pair.

name: maybe_Text_CharFilter_Match
signature: u32 maybe_Text_CharFilter_Match(int self, u8* outVisible, int charRecord, int kind, u32 filter, int inRect, int x, int y, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY, u32 layerMask)

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_ValidateSlot
summary: Reads the current command-buffer slot (self->f_18 indexed by its f_18 word, stride 0xC), computes the base+index*0x48 entry address and, when the slot's end index and write index disagree, falls into the 12x0x70-byte construct-array path.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOptionalPasses
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOptionalPasses(GfxModelInstance* self, void* cmd, void* ctx, int include_hidden)

name: Gfx_Node_CreateChild
signature: int* Gfx_Node_CreateChild(GfxNode* parent, uint32_t heap, uint32_t desc)
summary: Creates a 0x7C-byte child node: Mem_AllocAligned_2, constructor 0x005776B0, initialisation from the descriptor (Gfx_SpriteSet_Init) and insertion into the parent's intrusive child list (func_001235A4); returns 0 on failure.

name: Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord44
signature: void Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord44(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)

name: Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord20
signature: void Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord20(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)

evidence: The grow helper is the now-named std_Vector20_Reserve (20 = 0x14 bytes) and the dirty-flag write is visible, so the record size in the old 'Add14' name is explained and the append role is mechanical.

name: maybe_Field_HandleList_Ctor
summary: Initialises a small handle list: installs the local vtable 0x784304, builds the 8-byte allocator wrapper (vtable 0x782B10) and a 0x94-byte reader object (func_0058C40C), so the list owns its own reader/handle pair.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateBalloonAnchors
summary: Refreshes the per-member balloon anchors on the battle member screen: reads the leader/target positions, clears the 'has target' flag, computes the anchor offsets (Camera_ComputePointAtDistance) and forwards them to the action-sequence attachment code.
evidence: The callees now carry the battle-UI names Battle_Ui_GetBalloonAnchor and Battle_Ui_CancelBalloon and the sole caller is Battle_Ui_MemberScreen_Update, so the FieldParty_ prefix of the old name was on the wrong side of the battle/field boundary; which group object it walks is still assumed.

name: maybe_Ui_TextScreen_Ctor_77E564
summary: Constructor of a screen object with a text cache: Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache plus maybe_Ui_TextLineCache_InitAndReturn, vtable 0x77E564, the -1/0 defaults at 0xC98/0xC99 and a six-word default block.

summary: Same text-cache screen family as 0x0059DE54 but with vtable 0x77E6B8: Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache, the -1/0 defaults at 0xC98/0xC99 and an extra trailing state word at 0xC9D.

name: Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateBlendSlots
signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateBlendSlots(RenderObject* self, u32* packet, int flags)
summary: Interpolates the two material-blend weights (f_1E0/f_1E8) with Anim_AdvanceTimelineValue and writes them, with the texture/colour pointers, into the render packet slots 0x44..0x4F; releases the old texture binding when the slot changes.
evidence: The callee set (Gfx_TextureBinding_Release, Anim_AdvanceTimelineValue, func_0055E61C) and the caller Gfx_RenderObject_BindBlendMaterialSet now show the blend-slot update, so both the interpolation and the slot write are accounted for.

name: maybe_Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateWithScaleOverride
signature: void maybe_Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateWithScaleOverride(RenderObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
summary: Render-object update variant that writes the value from the parameter object (self->f_208->f_C) into the renderer scale field at (*(self->f_10+4)+0x160)+0x134, runs the renderer prepare hook and then tail-calls Gfx_RenderObject_Update.

name: Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateScaled
signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateScaled(RenderObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
summary: Same as the normal render-object update but multiplies the renderer scale by self->f_20C (the per-object scale factor) before tail-calling Gfx_RenderObject_Update.
evidence: The multiply by f_20C is visible and the tail target is the confidently named Gfx_RenderObject_Update, so the 'scaled update' reading is supported by code, not by naming alone.

name: Sq_VmCallBinaryMetaMethod
summary: Pushes the two operands of a binary operator and invokes the operator metamethod stored in vm->f_48 through Sq_VmCall, then pops the two slots.

name: Field2D_Sprite_UpdateState
summary: Advances a large 2D field sprite's state: resolves the current animation frame (func_00632FB8/0x00633064), updates its transform and plays the associated SE through Sound_PlaySeById/Field2D_Sprite_ApplySoundTrigger.
evidence: The callees Sound_PlaySeById and Field2D_Sprite_ApplySoundTrigger plus the callers Field2D_Sprite_ApplySoundTrigger / 0x197E98 show the frame+transform+SE update; the exact meaning of arg2 is still open.

name: Font_GlyphSprite_Ctor
signature: GlyphSprite* Font_GlyphSprite_Ctor(GlyphSprite* storage, u32 textureId, u32 paletteId, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
summary: Constructor for a font glyph sprite: installs the vtable pair, builds the inner quad with Font_GlyphQuad_Create, creates the sprite actor from the table, sets the animation id, inserts it into the UI spatial hash and attaches the texture.
evidence: The callees Font_GlyphQuad_Create, Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable and Ui_SpatialHash_Insert are all named and cover the constructor body, so the glyph-sprite reading is confirmed.

name: Field2D_Sprite_StartPathMovement
summary: Starts moving a 2D field sprite toward a target cell: caches the chip size minus one in f_38, copies the target into f_D0..f_DC, then for both path owners (host+0x2D0/0x2D4) asks maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep for the next step and registers it as the sprite's motion callback.

name: maybe_Field2D_MapChip_MapPointToCell
signature: void maybe_Field2D_MapChip_MapPointToCell(Cell* out, Field2DActor* self, unsigned int point)
summary: Maps a screen/scene point to a 2D map cell: clamps it with maybe_Field2D_MapChip_GetColumnInfo against the actor's +0x78/+0x7C position and, when the point moved, transforms it through Field2D_Actor_TransformPosition; returns the cell or zero when the transform fails.

name: Ui_ObjectList_AllocEntries
summary: Allocates and constructs five 0x230-byte row objects from the UI heap, gives each a fresh serial id from a global counter and links it into the object's entry list at +0x194.

summary: Clears the list and destroys the ten slots at +0x88, then resets the selection/index word at +0x808 to 0xFF.

name: Field_SceneNode_HideRendererDeep
signature: void Field_SceneNode_HideRendererDeep(SceneNode* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
summary: Hides a scene node's renderer and everything below it: when the render core is idle (core+0x40 == 0) it asks the node's renderer object for mode 3 and calls vtable slot 0x24 on every child in the intrusive list; 0x005E74C8 is the mode-4 show twin.

name: maybe_Field_Object_GetStateCode
summary: Returns the object's coarse state code (6 or 7): state byte f_310 == 1 yields 7 immediately, 2 yields 6, otherwise the object's 16-bit id is checked through maybe_Field_Object_IsStatusFull and a global flag, then f_310 is cleared.

name: Sound_Stream_EnsureCapacity
signature: unsigned Sound_Stream_EnsureCapacity(Sound_StreamPool* pool, unsigned requirement, const unsigned* requirements)
summary: Grows the stream pools to satisfy a requirement record: looks the requirement id up among the 5-word records in arg3 and reallocates the node, entry, list and packet pools through the allocator when their capacities are too small, relinking the existing entries.

name: MoLive_Stream_BindPacket
signature: void MoLive_Stream_BindPacket(u32 map_context, MoLiveStream* stream, MoLivePacket* packet)
summary: Hands a packet to a MoLive stream: calls vtable+0x18 (attach), asks vtable+0x10 whether the stream accepted it and, if so, records the packet's time (+0x14) in the stream's field +0x14.

summary: Takes one free 0x18-byte node from the stream pool: reuses the last node of the preallocated pool or allocates a new one and publishes it as the current node; returns 0 when the pool is exhausted.
evidence: The free-node array at pool[8]/pool[10], the 0x18 allocation and the std_SlotVector_DestroyRangeRelease shrink are visible, and the two callers (MoLive_StreamTable_BeginPackets, MoLive_Reader_ReadEp) consume the node as the next packet.

name: Sound_Stream_BuildChunk
signature: unsigned Sound_Stream_BuildChunk(Sound_Stream* stream, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, int arg4)

evidence: The ring walk (f_30/f_38/f_3C) plus std_RingBuffer_CopyWrapped and std_SlotVector_Append now describe the chunk assembly completely, and the caller MoLive_StreamTable_CommitPackets is the matching consumer.

name: Node_UpdateAttachedEffectTransform
summary: World transform of an effect attached to a node: takes the node basis from f_27, offsets it toward the target point, rotates it (0x00574548) and writes the position/angle back through Gfx_UpdateEffectPosition.
evidence: The callees maybe_Gfx_UpdateEffectPosition and func_00574548 plus the acos/sqrt angle computation cover the body, and all five callers are node-attachment code (0x005F58D0/0x005F59E4/0x005F605C/0x005F6248/0x005F6384).

summary: Releases the node's four attached effect handles: lazily allocates the shared effect-owner object once, then for each of the four slots releases the handle through Effect_ReleaseHandle and marks the slot free (0xFFFFFC00).
evidence: Effect_ReleaseHandle is the named effect API and the four-slot loop with the 0xFFFFFC00 sentinel is visible; eight effect-detach call sites (Actor_CreateBehaviourTasks, Field_Action_ResetActor, the node dtor ...) consume it.

name: maybe_Data_IsSlotEmpty
signature: unsigned int maybe_Data_IsSlotEmpty(unsigned int* slots, int index)
summary: Reports whether a slot in an 8-byte-stride pointer array is free: true when the slot holds no pointer, or (for index 0) when the lazily created slot manager reports fewer than two live users.

name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_TickChildren
summary: Animation tick for a scene node: runs the base idle/visibility step and then advances every child through virtual slot +0x18.

name: Casino_AddJackpotPayout
signature: void Casino_AddJackpotPayout(int variant, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Adds one payout step to the casino jackpot pool: refreshes the counters, takes the slot-0 stored value and advances it along the selected growth curve (clock +0x64/0x78/0x8C) with Casino_CalcJackpotPayoutAmount.
evidence: The callee set is now the confidently named Casino_IsJackpotClockExpired / Casino_RefreshJackpotCounters / Casino_CalcJackpotPayoutAmount, and the caller Ui_JackpotScreen_StartPayout drives it, so the jackpot-payout role is confirmed.

signature: void Casino_AddJackpotPayoutEx(int variant, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

evidence: Identical structure to 0x00601320 with the same named Casino_* callees and only the curve offsets different, and the caller is the jackpot screen path 0x002C6FE4.

summary: Deducts a payout from the jackpot pool: clamps the new value against the current clock value, stores it back as the pool's current value and propagates the difference through the four history entries with Casino_RollJackpotPayout.

name: BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel_2
signature: void BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel_2(BattleScene* self, unsigned handle, int count, int index, int variant)
summary: Places a battle unit model on screen: resolves the node (func_005F5818), puts it in state 4, computes its slot position from the entry count and index (staggering rows when several units share a slot) and writes the resulting transform through BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform.
evidence: The callees BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform / Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection and the slot-list read func_001CA3E4 match the layout role, and the two callers (0x606DA4, 0x60BBB8) are scene layout refreshes; the '_2' suffix stays because the body is a near-duplicate of the unit-layout path.

name: Field_NpcAction_AdvanceState
summary: Chooses the next NPC action state: if the NPC's target is out of the interaction range it switches to the return/idle state, otherwise to the approach-player state, using the task timers and spawning the associated effect at the actor offset.
evidence: The body sends states 3/9/10 through func_005E7848 and reads the task timers, and the caller Field_NpcAction_UpdateSightReaction is the named sight-reaction step; Field_Object_SpawnEffectAtOffset / func_0062B8A4 are the effect and lookup helpers.

name: Ui_TextListWindow_UpdateItemRects
summary: Recomputes the source/destination rectangles of the list rows: takes the measured text width from virtual +0x8, adds the window padding and pushes both UV rectangles to the text renderer with the numeric formatter.
evidence: The body measures through func_0011CD80 and writes two rects with func_001A6680/func_006F0E1C formatting, and the callers include Ui_TextListWindow_InitPanes, so both the class and the rect update are supported.
